name: paperzilla
description: Connect Codex to Paperzilla research feeds through the Paperzilla MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Read Paperzilla research feeds from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Paperzilla's MCP server so agents can list projects, read curated feeds, search papers, fetch Atom URLs, and retrieve paper details or markdown using a Paperzilla MCP key.
